badge.book_closed.note: You collected every tab you wrote.
badge.first_beat.note: A regular's story opened for the first time.
badge.first_expand.note: You took a tier up for the first time - more tables, more rent.
badge.first_ten_k.note: The till passed ten thousand for the first time.
badge.full_house.note: On a peak day nobody was turned away and nobody walked out angry.
badge.short_peak.note: You worked below the crew you needed and still nobody left a table angry.

notice.plates_out: Out of clean plates — the kitchen is waiting. {0} dirty plates at the sink.
notice.plates_out_busy: Out of clean plates — whoever is on the sink cannot keep up. {0} dirty plates at the sink.
notice.regular_upset: {0} is put out — away for {1} days.
notice.rejected: That cannot be done right now.
notice.rejected_book: The book is full — collect first.
notice.rejected_budget: That is enough for today — carry on tomorrow.
notice.rejected_cash: Not enough cash in the till.
notice.save_failed: Could not write the save — check your device storage.
notice.service_done: Service is over — you can close the day.
notice.tenure_lokanta: {0} has been here {1} days. Doesn't need to ask any more.
notice.tenure_zincir: {0} has worked {1} days of shifts. The new starters come to them with their questions.
notice.turned_away: A group walked away — nothing on the menu could be made
regular.burak.beat1: Opens his laptop, orders without making you wait.
regular.burak.beat3: “I'll be remote now, but this is basically my office.”
regular.burak.name: Ben
regular.cem_abi.beat1: Bike out front, helmet in hand.
regular.cem_abi.beat2: “Put you in the couriers' group chat.”
regular.cem_abi.beat3: “Opening my own place. Learned the trade from you.”
regular.cem_abi.name: Jamie
regular.deniz.beat1: Straight after school, backpack on one shoulder, in a hurry.
regular.deniz.beat2: “This is where we all meet up now.”
regular.deniz.beat3: Passed the exam. “Celebration's here. Six of us.”
regular.deniz.name: Danny
regular.elif.beat1: Arrives with shopping bags, has fifteen minutes.
regular.elif.beat2: “Saw it through the window — you've added something new.”
regular.elif.beat3: “Told the girls at the shop. We order from you now.”
regular.elif.name: Ellie
regular.guler_hanim.beat1: In and out on her feet, takes the pilaf away with her.
regular.guler_hanim.beat2: “I tell my clients to go across the road to you.”
regular.guler_hanim.beat3: Expanding her shop. “We grew together, you and I.”
regular.guler_hanim.name: Mrs Gale
regular.hasan_usta.beat1: Looks straight at the kitchen on the way in. “Any bean stew?”
regular.hasan_usta.beat2: Doesn't order any more. He sits down; you know.
regular.hasan_usta.beat3: “My son's back from the army. I'll bring him tonight.”
regular.hasan_usta.name: Old Harry
regular.ismail_sofor.beat1: Parks the lorry on the corner, eats fast, leaves.
regular.ismail_sofor.beat2: “Coming back from Ankara, I always stop here now.”
regular.ismail_sofor.beat3: Said it on the radio: “Two more drivers will ask for you.”
regular.ismail_sofor.name: Big Mal
regular.kaan_hoca.beat1: Straight after training, asking about protein.
regular.kaan_hoca.beat2: “I tell my clients to eat here.”
regular.kaan_hoca.beat3: “Pinned your address to the gym board. Hope that's alright.”
regular.kaan_hoca.name: Coach Kane
regular.mehmet_dede.beat1: Hesitates at the door. “This used to be somebody else's.”
regular.mehmet_dede.beat2: “The chickpeas were like this back then. Exactly.”
regular.mehmet_dede.beat3: He comes every day now. Everyone knows which chair is his.
regular.mehmet_dede.name: Grandad Mick
regular.melis.beat1: Reads the price list from top to bottom.
regular.melis.beat2: “I'll keep the books, you make the food.”
regular.melis.beat3: “I'm curious about your margins. Not joking.”
regular.melis.name: Melissa
regular.nazife_teyze.beat1: Tastes the soup, says nothing. She'll be back tomorrow.
regular.nazife_teyze.beat2: “Mine used to taste like this. Years ago.”
regular.nazife_teyze.beat3: Pauses at the door: “This place is the face of the street now.”
regular.nazife_teyze.name: Auntie Pat
regular.nurten_abla.beat1: Short break. Always takes the cacık with her.
regular.nurten_abla.beat2: “Three more coming from the workshop — keep us a table.”
regular.nurten_abla.beat3: The workshop is closing. “New place is far, but I'll come.”
regular.nurten_abla.name: Nora
regular.okan.beat1: Asks what the cheapest thing on the menu is.
regular.okan.beat2: “Grant came through.” Today he orders dessert too.
regular.okan.beat3: Starting an internship. “First paycheque, I'm buying here.”
regular.okan.name: Owen
regular.ozan.beat1: After the match, with the whole team, loud.
regular.ozan.beat2: “We come here when we win. You're our lucky charm.”
regular.ozan.beat3: “We took the cup. Shall we put your name on the shirt?”
regular.ozan.name: Ollie
regular.perihan_hanim.beat1: Holds the fork up to the light. Says nothing, but looks.
regular.perihan_hanim.beat2: “The tablecloth is clean today. I noticed.”
regular.perihan_hanim.beat3: “I'm not easy to please. I like this place.”
regular.perihan_hanim.name: Mrs Perry
regular.rasim_amca.beat1: Hands dusty with lime. Shakes out his jacket before sitting.
regular.rasim_amca.beat2: “Told the lads too — lunch is here from now on.”
regular.rasim_amca.beat3: The site is finishing. “I'll still drop by, don't worry.”
regular.rasim_amca.name: Uncle Ray
regular.selim_bey.beat1: Same table, same hour. Never a minute off.
regular.selim_bey.beat2: “Forty minutes for lunch. I'm out of here by thirty-five.”
regular.selim_bey.beat3: Talks about retiring. “Then I'll come more often.”
regular.selim_bey.name: Mr Talbot
regular.sevda.beat1: Asks about the salad: “Can I get the dressing on the side?”
regular.sevda.beat2: “I recommend this place to the people I see.”
regular.sevda.beat3: “Your menu is on the clinic wall now.”
regular.sevda.name: Sadie
regular.tolga.beat1: Comes at midnight. Surprised the door is open.
regular.tolga.beat2: “You're the only place open at this hour.”
regular.tolga.beat3: “The other guards started coming too. Did you notice?”
regular.tolga.name: Terry
regular.yagmur.beat2: “This is the one good moment of my day.”
regular.yagmur.beat3: “Course is over. But it's a habit now — I'll be back.”
regular.yagmur.name: Yvonne
trait.cabuk_yorulan.desc: Slows down in the last quarter of the day.
trait.cabuk_yorulan.voice: Leans on the counter more as the day goes on.
trait.cirak.voice: New to this. Show it once and it stays.
trait.dayanikli.desc: Works at the same pace until closing.
trait.dayanikli.voice: Still at the morning's pace when the shutters come down.
trait.ekip_moralini_yukselten.voice: People gather round on the break.
trait.hizli_ama_daginik.desc: Quick to serve, slow to clear tables.
trait.hizli_ama_daginik.voice: Gets the order out fast. The hurry stops when it's time to clear.
trait.huysuz.voice: Has a problem with everyone. Right about most of them.
trait.kalabalikta_panikleyen.desc: Slows down noticeably at the busiest hour.
trait.kalabalikta_panikleyen.voice: Loses the thread when the room fills up.
trait.musteriyle_iyi_anlasan.desc: Guests leave happier when they take the bill.
trait.musteriyle_iyi_anlasan.voice: Guests thank them by name on the way out.
trait.sakin.voice: The busiest hour goes by without a raised voice.
trait.suratsiz.desc: Guests leave less happy when they take the bill.
trait.suratsiz.voice: Does the work, says nothing. Some tables take it personally.
trait.tecrubeli.voice: Thirty years in. Never has to ask.
trait.yavas_ama_titiz.desc: Plates it better, but takes longer.
trait.yavas_ama_titiz.voice: Checks the plate once more before letting it go.
